gaps.semantic_requirement: Complete issuer-specific CSRC/SSE historical regulatory and major-discipline result universe.
gaps.exact_missing_reason: Historical official result pagination/anti-bot universe was not fully retrievable and no unrestricted export was available.
gaps.consequence: The current regulatory risk slot remains missing_evidence, not a negative conclusion.
gaps.allowed_future_action: Run a newly authorized bounded official regulator/exchange retrieval with complete pagination evidence.
gaps.prohibited_fallback: Do not use general search results, absence inference, or missing pages as proof that no regulatory event exists.

gaps.semantic_requirement: Complete historical discipline evidence for controlling-shareholder fund occupation or related guarantee beyond annual-report statements.
gaps.exact_missing_reason: Historical SSE discipline search was not fully retrievable and no unrestricted disciplinary export was available.
gaps.consequence: The current fund-occupation/related-guarantee slot remains missing_evidence, not a negative conclusion.
gaps.allowed_future_action: Run a newly authorized bounded official discipline retrieval with complete pagination evidence.
gaps.prohibited_fallback: Do not infer absence from annual reports alone or classify ordinary related-party balances as fund occupation.

gaps.semantic_requirement: Direct FY2024 operating-tax expense matched to the consolidated operating-profit numerator scope.
gaps.exact_missing_reason: Only total current/deferred income tax and rate reconciliation are disclosed; no direct operating-tax allocation exists in the searched report.
gaps.consequence: The NOPAT numerator cannot be constructed under the strict direct-evidence contract.
gaps.allowed_future_action: Reopen only for a newly published direct issuer/exchange/audited disclosure or separately approved methodology review.
gaps.prohibited_fallback: No effective/statutory tax rate, total tax expense, tax plug, manual allocation, or zero fill.

gaps.semantic_requirement: Complete separate associate-investment balance including individually immaterial holdings.
gaps.exact_missing_reason: Major associates/JVs are separate, but remaining individually immaterial holdings are disclosed only as a combined amount.
gaps.consequence: Opening invested-capital scope cannot match the frozen associate/JV treatment.
gaps.allowed_future_action: Use a new direct separate disclosure or conduct a separate North-Star-approved methodology review.
gaps.prohibited_fallback: No residual associate/JV split, proportional allocation, manual plug, or weaker scope match.

gaps.allowed_future_action: Use new direct official purpose/income linkage or conduct a separate North-Star-approved methodology review.
gaps.prohibited_fallback: No all-cash deduction, unsupported asset-class deduction, residual classification, manual plug, or zero fill.
